messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning to deploy users.email_hash column migration tomorrow 21:00 PST. Plan:
- add column (instant)
- dual-write on for 1h
- backfill batch jobs
- cutover to read from new index
Who can own the window? I'll be on-call but need an owner for the deploy and rollback checks.

jia: I can own the deploy window. I'll be on standby 20:30–22:30 PST. What's the expected backfill duration?

sam: Backfill estimate ~30–45m at current throughput. We'll run 4 parallel workers. I'll pre-run a sample job against staging tonight. If it exceeds 1h we abort and fall back to extended dual-write.

maria: Quick checklist please:
- run preflight with `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE email_hash IS NULL;`
- confirm replica lag < 5s
- set DB_SAFE_MODE=1 on rollback path
- smoke: create user -> login -> email-index lookup

tim: I'll do smoke scripts. Adding test commands:
```
curl -XPOST /smoke -d '{"user": "smoke+test"}'
kubectl logs deploy/users-backfill --since=1h | tail -n 200
```

ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: <https://tracker/RED-4021|RED-4021> Scheduled 1967894321. Patch: schema/V2/email_hash_add.sql. Notifying infra for slot reservation.

nora: Rollback plan: prefer toggling application feature flag to read old index instead of immediate DROP. Prepare flag in prod toggle service. I can own feature-flag rollback.

sam: owners confirmed: Jia (deploy), Nora (rollback flag), Tim (smoke), Sam (on-call). Preflight run at 19:45 PST — who can run it?

jia: I'll run preflight and post results here. Ping if you need access to audit logs.

maria: One more: ensure metric alert for error rate >1% during window. I'll add a temporary alert and remove after 24h if stable.

tim: Also confirm backup snapshot taken at 20:00 PST, retained 7 days.

sam: SGTM. I'll push the canary migration to a single shard at 20:45 then scale up. If any rollback triggers, we fallback to dual-write + feature flag and stop backfill.

jia: noted. I'll be online in #eng-oncall at 20:30. Posting preflight outputs in this thread.

ops-bot: Reminder 60m before window. :alarm_clock:
